title: Ralph Reese
description: Explains Ralph Reese: "With so many interesting-looking critters in the whole Jabba sequence, the problem for an illustrator is not so much what to put in as what to leave out. Here we see smuggler Solo smooth-talking his way into a big loan from the interstellar loan shark/gangster, which he somehow never gets around to repaying." After several years in cornics doing mostly horror and fantasy material and contributing regularly to NATIONAL LAMPOON, Reese drifted into children's books and advertising work for quite a while. Recently, he's been inking MAGNUS, ROBOT FIGHTER and other titles for Valiant, after successfully avoiding super-heroes for the last twenty years.
